title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 105-108 (Mahakali, Brahmavishnushivatmika, Trikalajnanasampanna, Bhuvaneshwari)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 105 to 108: Mahakali, Brahmavishnushivatmika, Trikalajnanasampanna, Bhuvaneshwari, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 105 to 108 with meaning
caption: Names 105 to 108 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 105 to 108**: **Mahakali, Brahmavishnushivatmika, Trikalajnanasampanna, Bhuvaneshwari**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Mahakali, Brahmavishnushivatmika, Trikalajnanasampanna, Bhuvaneshwari.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Mahakali** means **Great Kali**. In the Devi Mahatmya the Goddess has three great forms: Mahakali, Mahalakshmi and Mahasaraswati.

sections.h: Brahmavishnushivatmika: Whose Self is Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva
p: **Brahmavishnushivatmika** means **Whose Self is Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva**. She is the power behind creation, preservation and dissolution.

sections.h: Trikalajnanasampanna: Knower of past, present and future
p: **Trikalajnanasampanna** means **Knower of past, present and future**. She knows the past, the present and the future.
**Bhuvaneshwari** means **Ruler of the worlds**. Ruler of all the worlds; Bhuvaneshwari is also one of the ten Mahavidyas.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
